Class OptimizationResult

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model.OptimizationResult
public class OptimizationResult extends Object
The complete result of a metro optimization run, containing ranked recommendations, deployment topology, latency data, risk assessment, cost estimates, and formatted report outputs.
